 Description

 mastersingh24 
 opened on Sep 15, 2026 

 Issue body actions 

 Overview

 Record an immutable audit trail of all SRE triage interactions (spatial node selections, AI prompts, traffic drain adjustments, rollbacks, and hot-patches) during an incident session and allow 1-click export to a formatted Google SRE Post-Mortem Markdown artifact.

 Key Deliverables

 Track timestamped incident events in session state.

 Add an interactive Incident Timeline drawer in the HUD.

 Provide a Export Post-Mortem (.md) button that generates a structured incident report with root cause, blast radius summary, and remediation timeline.
